turns.text: I fixed the bug and the full test suite now passes. `InteractiveParser.copy()` copied the lexer thread, but the copied parser state still pointed at the original one (`ParserState.copy` reuses `self.lexer`). Because `resume_parse()` lexes from the parser state's lexer, the copy re-lexed the original, untouched text and appended those tokens again. I changed `copy()` in `lark/parsers/lalr_interactive_parser.py` so the new parser state uses the copied lexer thread too.

summary: I fixed the bug and the full test suite now passes. `InteractiveParser.copy()` copied the lexer thread, but the copied parser state still pointed at the original one (`ParserState.copy` reuses `self.lexer`). Because `resume_parse()` lexes from the parser state's lexer, the copy re-lexed the original, untouched text and appended those tokens again. I changed `copy()` in `lark/parsers/lalr_interactive_parser.py` so the new parser state uses the copied lexer thread too.
